{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Cream silk blouse, tailored fit, cropped at the waist, color #FFFDD0, lightweight woven fabric.
Charcoal wool trousers, straight-leg cut, full length reaching the ankle, color #36454F, heavy textured wool blend.
Nude leather loafers, pointed-toe shape, medium height with a low block heel, color #E0C090, smooth calfskin leather.
Gold minimalist hoop earrings, circular design with a polished finish, shiny metal, yellow gold alloy.
This outfit strikes the perfect balance between professional polish and autumnal warmth while adhering to office-appropriate standards. The cream blouse adds a soft, approachable touch that contrasts beautifully with the structured charcoal trousers, creating a visually harmonious silhouette suitable for cooler weather. Completing the look with nude loafers extends the leg line elegantly without adding bulk, ensuring comfort throughout a long workday."}
